segments.sn22.36:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn22.36:1.3: “sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyan”ti.
segments.sn22.36:1.7: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatī”ti.
segments.sn22.36:2.1: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsī”ti?
segments.sn22.36:2.4: Vedanaṃ ce anuseti … saññaṃ ce anuseti … saṅkhāre ce anuseti …
segments.sn22.36:2.9: Rūpaṃ ce, bhante, nānuseti na taṃ anumīyati;
segments.sn22.36:2.10: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
segments.sn22.36:2.11: Vedanaṃ ce nānuseti … saññaṃ ce nānuseti … saṅkhāre ce nānuseti …
segments.sn22.36:2.14: viññāṇaṃ ce nānuseti na taṃ anumīyati;
segments.sn22.36:2.15: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
segments.sn22.36:2.16: Imassa khvāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī”ti.
segments.sn22.36:3.2: Sādhu kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
segments.sn22.36:3.3: Rūpaṃ ce, bhikkhu, anuseti taṃ anumīyati;
segments.sn22.36:3.5: Vedanaṃ ce, bhikkhu … saññaṃ ce, bhikkhu … saṅkhāre ce, bhikkhu …
segments.sn22.36:3.8: viññāṇaṃ ce, bhikkhu, anuseti taṃ anumīyati;
segments.sn22.36:3.10: Rūpaṃ ce, bhikkhu, nānuseti na taṃ anumīyati;
segments.sn22.36:3.11: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
segments.sn22.36:3.12: Vedanaṃ ce nānuseti … saññaṃ ce nānuseti … saṅkhāre ce nānuseti …
segments.sn22.36:3.15: viññāṇaṃ ce nānuseti na taṃ anumīyati;
segments.sn22.36:3.16: yaṃ nānumīyati na tena saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
segments.sn22.36:3.17: Imassa kho, bhikkhu, mayā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo”ti … pe …
segments.sn22.36:3.18: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.

lines: Catutthe taṃ anumīyatīti taṃ anusayitaṃ rūpaṃ marantena anusayena anumarati.
Na hi ārammaṇe bhijjamāne tadārammaṇā dhammā tiṭṭhanti.
Yaṃ anumīyatīti yaṃ rūpaṃ yena anusayena anumarati.
Tena saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti tena anusayena “ratto duṭṭho mūḷho”ti saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
Atha vā yanti karaṇavacanametaṃ, yena anusayena anumīyati, tena “ratto duṭṭho mūḷho”ti saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti attho.
Taṃ anusayitaṃ rūpanti taṃ rāgādinā anusayitaṃ rūpaṃ marantena anusayena anumarati.
